ghost_suspects.label: N5
reasons: no bonded partner even via symmetry
ghost_suspects.advice: delete-and-refine test: R1 rise <0.002 means no real density - delete it (never keep chemistry-free atoms just to lower R1). R1 rise >=0.002 means the density is real but unexplained - model it as guest solvent (rename e.g. OW, check H-bond partners) OR absorb it in the solvent mask; never both, and never leave it as an anonymous atom
